title: Pipeline
description: Every pipeline run with its ingestion and transformation steps, the warehouse it writes to, and the eRPC proxy in front of the chains.

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: select run_key as __value, status || ', started ' || case when now() - started_at < interval '1 hour' then extract(minute from now() - started_at)::int || ' min ago' when now() - started_at < interval '2 days' then floor(extract(epoch from now() - started_at) / 3600)::int || ' h ago' else extract(day from now() - started_at)::int || ' days ago' end || ', ' || left(run_key, 8) as __text from ops.pipeline_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) order by started_at desc
list.definition: select run_key as __value, status || ', started ' || case when now() - started_at < interval '1 hour' then extract(minute from now() - started_at)::int || ' min ago' when now() - started_at < interval '2 days' then floor(extract(epoch from now() - started_at) / 3600)::int || ' h ago' else extract(day from now() - started_at)::int || ' days ago' end || ', ' || left(run_key, 8) as __text from ops.pipeline_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) order by started_at desc

target.rawSql: select started_at as time, finished_at as timeend, status || ' run ' || left(run_key, 8) as text, status as tags from ops.pipeline_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Pipeline runs that started in the time range.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from ops.pipeline_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs in the time range where a source or the dbt build failed.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from ops.pipeline_runs where status = 'failed' and $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: How the most recent run ended.

targets.rawSql: select status from ops.pipeline_runs order by started_at desc limit 1

panels.title: Since the last successful run
panels.description: Turns orange after 25 hours, when a daily run is overdue, and red after 49.

targets.rawSql: select extract(epoch from now() - max(finished_at)) from ops.pipeline_runs where status = 'succeeded'

panels.title: Records written
panels.description: Records all sources wrote to the raw schema in the time range.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(records_written), 0) from ops.pipeline_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Median run duration
panels.description: From the first step's start to the last step's end.

targets.rawSql: select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from finished_at - started_at)) from ops.pipeline_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Every run
panels.description: One row per Dagster run, and per source or dbt build started by hand. Click a run to show its steps below and zoom every panel to its time.

targets.rawSql:
select started_at as "Started", status as "Status",
  extract(epoch from finished_at - started_at) as "Duration",
  sources_failed as "Sources failed", tests_failed as "Tests failed", records_written as "Records",
  failed_calls as "Failed calls", models_built as "Models built", models_not_built as "Models not built",
  tests_passed as "Tests passed", sources as "Sources", left(dagster_run_id, 8) as "Dagster run", run_key as "Run",
  run_key, dagster_run_id,
  (extract(epoch from started_at) * 1000)::bigint - 60000 as from_ms,
  (extract(epoch from finished_at) * 1000)::bigint + 60000 as to_ms
from ops.pipeline_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) order by started_at desc

panels.title: Status
panels.description: The run picked in the Run menu at the top, or by clicking a run in Every run.

targets.rawSql: select status from ops.pipeline_runs where run_key = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Duration
panels.description: From the first step's start to the last step's end.

targets.rawSql: select extract(epoch from finished_at - started_at) from ops.pipeline_runs where run_key = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Records written
panels.description: Records the run's sources wrote to the raw schema.

targets.rawSql: select records_written from ops.pipeline_runs where run_key = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Failed calls
panels.description: Calls that failed in this run and wait as dead letters.

targets.rawSql: select failed_calls from ops.pipeline_runs where run_key = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Models built
panels.description: dbt models the run built.

targets.rawSql: select models_built from ops.pipeline_runs where run_key = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Tests failed
panels.description: dbt tests that failed or errored in this run.

targets.rawSql: select tests_failed from ops.pipeline_runs where run_key = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Steps
panels.description: When each step ran, measured from the start of the run. dbt tests appear as one bar.

targets.rawSql:
with steps as (
  select source || '.' || table_name as step, started_at, finished_at
  from ops.ingestion_runs where coalesce(dagster_run_id, run_id::text) = ${run:sqlstring}
  union all
  select 'dbt build', i.started_at, i.finished_at from ops.dbt_invocations i where coalesce(i.dagster_run_id, i.invocation_id::text) = ${run:sqlstring}
  union all
  select 'dbt ' || n.name, n.started_at, n.finished_at
  from ops.dbt_node_runs n join ops.dbt_invocations i using (invocation_id)
  where coalesce(i.dagster_run_id, i.invocation_id::text) = ${run:sqlstring} and n.resource_type <> 'test' and n.started_at is not null
  union all
  select 'dbt tests (' || count(*) || ')', min(n.started_at), max(n.finished_at)
  from ops.dbt_node_runs n join ops.dbt_invocations i using (invocation_id)
  where coalesce(i.dagster_run_id, i.invocation_id::text) = ${run:sqlstring} and n.resource_type = 'test' and n.started_at is not null
  having count(*) > 0
)
select step as "Step", extract(epoch from started_at - min(started_at) over ()) as "Waiting",
  extract(epoch from finished_at - started_at) as "Running"
from steps order by started_at, step

panels.title: Ingestion
panels.description: Each source in the run. Extract is the time spent calling the chain, Load the time spent writing to the warehouse.

targets.rawSql:
select source || '.' || table_name as "Source", case when succeeded then 'succeeded' else 'failed' end as "Status",
  started_at as "Started", extract(epoch from finished_at - started_at) as "Duration",
  extract(epoch from finished_at - started_at) - load_seconds as "Extract", load_seconds as "Load",
  records_written as "Records", failed_calls as "Failed calls", retried_calls as "Retried",
  dead_letters_pending as "Pending dead letters", dead_letters_parked as "Parked dead letters", error as "Error"
from ops.ingestion_runs where coalesce(dagster_run_id, run_id::text) = ${run:sqlstring} order by started_at

panels.title: dbt build
panels.description: The dbt invocation of the run, and its error when it failed.

targets.rawSql:
select i.invocation_id as "Invocation", case when i.succeeded then 'succeeded' else 'failed' end as "Status",
  i.started_at as "Started", extract(epoch from i.finished_at - i.started_at) as "Duration",
  i.dbt_version as "dbt version", i.error as "Error"
from ops.dbt_invocations i where coalesce(i.dagster_run_id, i.invocation_id::text) = ${run:sqlstring} order by i.started_at

panels.title: dbt models and tests
panels.description: Every node the build selected. Rows written counts rows in table models; views report none. Failing rows counts the rows a test caught.

targets.rawSql:
select n.name as "Node", n.resource_type as "Type", n.status as "Status", n.started_at as "Started",
  n.execution_seconds as "Duration", n.rows_affected as "Rows written", n.failures as "Failing rows", n.message as "Message"
from ops.dbt_node_runs n join ops.dbt_invocations i using (invocation_id)
where coalesce(i.dagster_run_id, i.invocation_id::text) = ${run:sqlstring} order by n.started_at nulls last, n.name

panels.title: Slowest models
panels.description: The ten models that took longest to build in this run.

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: Each pipeline run and each dbt build.

targets.rawSql: select started_at as time, 'pipeline run' as metric, extract(epoch from finished_at - started_at) as value from ops.pipeline_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) order by 1
select started_at as time, 'dbt build' as metric, extract(epoch from finished_at - started_at) as value from ops.dbt_invocations where $__timeFilter(started_at) order by 1

panels.title: Ingestion duration by source
panels.description: How long each source's runs took.

targets.rawSql: select started_at as time, source || '.' || table_name as metric, extract(epoch from finished_at - started_at) as value from ops.ingestion_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) order by 1

panels.title: Records written by source
panels.description: Records each source's runs wrote to the raw schema.

targets.rawSql: select started_at as time, source || '.' || table_name as metric, records_written as value from ops.ingestion_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) order by 1

panels.title: Failed calls and dead letters by source
panels.description: Failed calls in each run, and the dead letters left after it.

targets.rawSql: select started_at as time, source || '.' || table_name || ' failed calls' as metric, failed_calls as value from ops.ingestion_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) order by 1

select started_at as time, source || '.' || table_name || ' dead letters' as metric, dead_letters_pending + dead_letters_parked as value from ops.ingestion_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) and dead_letters_pending is not null order by 1

panels.title: Model build time
panels.description: How long each dbt model took to build, per build.

targets.rawSql: select n.started_at as time, n.name as metric, n.execution_seconds as value from ops.dbt_node_runs n where n.resource_type = 'model' and n.started_at is not null and $__timeFilter(n.started_at) order by 1

panels.title: Rows in table models
panels.description: Rows each table model held after each build.

targets.rawSql: select n.started_at as time, n.name as metric, n.rows_affected as value from ops.dbt_node_runs n where n.rows_affected is not null and $__timeFilter(n.started_at) order by 1

panels.title: dbt test results
panels.description: Tests that passed, warned and failed in each build.

targets.rawSql: select started_at as time, tests_passed as passed, tests_warned as warned, tests_failed as failed from ops.pipeline_runs where transformed and $__timeFilter(started_at) order by 1

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Disk used by the warehouse database.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open connections to the warehouse database.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from memory in the time range.

panels.title: Transactions
panels.description: Transactions committed in the time range.

panels.title: Rollbacks
panels.description: Transactions rolled back in the time range.

panels.title: Deadlocks
panels.description: Deadlocks in the time range.

panels.title: Tables
panels.description: Every table in the warehouse database now. Rows is Postgres's running count, which ANALYZE corrects.

targets.rawSql:
select schemaname as "Schema", relname as "Table", n_live_tup as "Rows", n_dead_tup as "Dead rows",
  pg_total_relation_size(relid) as "Size", seq_scan as "Sequential scans", idx_scan as "Index scans",
  n_tup_ins as "Rows inserted", n_tup_upd as "Rows updated", n_tup_del as "Rows deleted",
  greatest(last_vacuum, last_autovacuum) as "Last vacuum", greatest(last_analyze, last_autoanalyze) as "Last analyze"
from pg_stat_user_tables order by pg_total_relation_size(relid) desc

panels.title: Rows by table
panels.description: Live rows in each table.

panels.title: Size by table
panels.description: Disk used by each table and its indexes.

panels.title: Rows changed by table
panels.description: Rows inserted, updated and deleted per second in each table.

panels.title: Row operations
panels.description: Rows the warehouse database inserted, updated, deleted and read per second.

panels.title: Transactions per second
panels.description: Commits and rollbacks.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: Open connections to the warehouse database by state.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio over time
panels.description: Share of block reads served from memory.

panels.title: Query time by user
panels.description: Seconds per second that queries ran, from pg_stat_statements. 1 means one query running at all times.

panels.title: Sequential scans by table
panels.description: Full table reads per second. Many on a large table can mean a missing index.

panels.title: Dead rows by table
panels.description: Rows that updates and deletes left behind until vacuum removes them.

panels.title: Queries that used the most time
panels.description: The pipeline's queries since pg_stat_statements was last reset, not limited to the time range. Leaves out the dashboard's own queries, and any statement that sets a password.

targets.rawSql:
select left(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(s.query, '^/\*.*?\*/', ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 300) as "Query",
  r.rolname as "User",
  s.calls as "Calls", s.total_exec_time as "Total time", s.mean_exec_time as "Mean time", s.max_exec_time as "Max time",
  s.rows as "Rows", s.shared_blks_hit::float / nullif(s.shared_blks_hit + s.shared_blks_read, 0) as "Cache hit ratio"
from pg_stat_statements s join pg_roles r on r.oid = s.userid join pg_database db on db.oid = s.dbid
where db.datname = current_database() and r.rolname <> 'monitor' and s.query !~* 'password'
order by s.total_exec_time desc limit 25

panels.description: Requests the ingestion sources sent to eRPC in the time range.

panels.title: Failed requests
panels.description: Requests eRPC could not answer after its retries, in the time range.

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Share of requests eRPC answered in the time range.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of requests took less than this, in the time range.

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of cache lookups that eRPC answered from its cache, in the time range.

panels.title: Rate limited
panels.description: Requests a rate limit held back in the time range.

panels.title: Requests by method
panels.description: Requests per second the sources sent, by chain and RPC method.

panels.title: Failed requests by error
panels.description: Requests per second that failed after eRPC's retries, by error.

panels.title: Latency by chain
panels.description: Time eRPC took to answer, retries included.

panels.title: Upstream requests
panels.description: Requests per second eRPC sent to each RPC provider. Includes retries and eRPC's own polling for new blocks, which runs when no source does.

panels.title: Upstream errors
panels.description: Errors per second from each RPC provider, by error.

panels.title: Upstream p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of each provider's answers took less than this.

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Retries per second, by chain and reason.

panels.title: Rate limits
panels.description: Requests per second a rate limit held back, by provider and budget.

panels.title: Cache lookups
panels.description: Cache hits and misses per second.

panels.title: Upstream block lag
panels.description: Blocks each provider is behind the most recent block any provider reports.

panels.title: Requests by provider
panels.description: Requests eRPC sent to each RPC provider in the time range.
